name: Electra 2 & 4 Channel Electrotherapy Unit with 7” Touch Screen
description: Electra 2 & 4 Channel Electrotherapy is a versatile electrotherapy unit designed for pain management, muscle stimulation, physical rehabilitation, and treatment of normoinnervated or denervated muscles. It is available in 2-channel and 4-channel configurations, with completely independent channels for flexible treatment planning. The system supports multiple current types, including diadynamic, faradic, pulse, direct, bipolar, and interferential currents. These options allow therapists to select suitable stimulation methods for different rehabilitation and electrotherapy applications. The diadynamic current can be used for painful inflammatory conditions affecting muscles, joints, and peripheral nerves, while faradic current supports stimulation of normally innervated muscles. Pulse current can be used for partially innervated or denervated muscles. Direct current also supports applications such as galvanization, galvanic baths, and iontophoresis. Electra features a 7-inch touch screen, preset treatment protocols, customized programs, and treatment-phase sequencing for each channel. Independent channels provide greater flexibility when managing different treatment requirements. Safety controls automatically deactivate the output current if an electrode becomes accidentally detached, helping provide safer treatment. The bipolar stimulation mode also helps improve sensory comfort during muscular stimulation. name: C-TEC NC951 Accessible Toilet Alarm Kit
description: C-TEC NC951 Accessible Toilet Alarm Kit is a 12V emergency assistance alarm system designed for accessible toilet applications. The kit includes the key components required for a Part M and BS8300 compliant emergency assistance alarm , excluding cables and fixings. The system includes an NC943B Single Zone Call Controller with rechargeable standby battery and relay, NC807C Ceiling Pull Unit, NC806CS Overdoor Light with Sounder, NC809DBBT Accessible Toilet Reset Point with Sounder, and NC949 Accessible WC Sticker . The ceiling pull unit features two open-sided triangular bangles designed for ease of use, while the reset point includes a RESET button, Braille text, reassurance LED and sounder . The overdoor light incorporates twin red LEDs and an onboard sounder to provide visual and audible indication when assistance is required. A key feature of the NC951 is its Call Accept functionality . When staff respond to an alarm, pressing the Call Accept button provides an intermittent reassurance signal inside the toilet, informing the user that assistance is on the way. Once assistance has been provided, the alarm can be cancelled using the Reset Point. The system uses a simple 12V configuration and can be expanded with up to three additional 800 Series Call System devices. Its rechargeable backup battery provides up to 24 hours of standby operation and 15 minutes of alarm running time . The NC951 can also be used as a single-zone emergency assistance alarm in applications such as changing rooms, interview rooms and reception areas.

description: INTELECT® RPW 2 Transmitters are standard transmitters designed for Radial Pressure Wave (RPW) therapy applications. Each transmitter has a specific shape and material intended to provide a particular energy flux density and wave profile for different treatment requirements. The range includes transmitters for trigger points and tendinopathies , including the Ro40, R15, C15 CERAMa-x®, A6, T10, F15 and ATLAS transmitters. These options are designed for different penetration depths and treatment intensities, ranging from low to high intensity. For myofascial treatments , the range includes the D20-S, D20-T and D35-S oscillators for applications involving muscles and connective tissue. The product range also includes specialized accessories for spine and fascia treatments , such as SPINE-ACTORS®, PERI-ACTOR® Knuckle, PERI-ACTOR Scoop, PERI-ACTOR Scraper and PERI-ACTOR Sphere. The vibration therapy transmitters include V10, V25 and V40 models, designed for applications ranging from superficial trigger points to larger muscle groups. Standard accessories shown in the product information include a FALCON® handpiece , transmitter trays, gel bottle support cup, transmission gel and other accessories. The ordering information also lists different RPW 2 unit sets for 230V, 120V and 100V configurations. name: INTELECT RPW Shockwave Therapy Unit with D-ACTOR Applicator
description: INTELECT RPW Shockwave Therapy Unit with D-ACTOR Applicator is a radial pressure wave therapy system designed for non-invasive treatment applications involving soft tissue and tendon-related conditions. The D-ACTOR applicator can be used with a variety of transmitters to generate shockwaves or a combination of shockwaves and vibrations. The system is designed for applications including myofascial trigger points, disorders of tendon insertions, activation and tightening of muscle and connective tissue, acupuncture, shockwave therapy, cellulite treatment (Stages I–III), elimination of lymphatic congestion, regulation of muscle tone and medical massage . Radial pressure wave therapy provides a non-invasive treatment approach for long-term insertion and soft tissue pathologies. According to the supplied product information, localized treatment is intended to enhance and reset the healing pattern while reducing pain and improving function. The stated physical effects include pain reduction, increased metabolism, revascularization and muscle tone recovery . The system provides adjustable compressed air output from 1.4 to 5 bar , with power increment settings of 2 bar . It operates at a pulse frequency of 0.5–21 Hz , with a pulse width of approximately 6–12 ms and a pressure vessel volume of 31 litres . Pulse amplitude is approximately 2 mm at 3 bar while idling without coupling . The standard accessory kit includes the D-ACTOR handpiece applicator, R15 15 mm ESWT transmitter, D20-S 20 mm D-ACTOR transmitter, projectiles, sealing set, guide tubes, cleaning brush, transmission gel, patient data card and user manual . Additional and optional transmitters/accessories include the D35 D-ACTOR 35 mm transmitter, F15 Focus-Lens 15 mm transmitter, DI15 Deep Impact 15 mm transmitter, C15 CERAMa-x ESWT 15 mm transmitter and V-ACTOR handpiece kit with V25 and V40 vibration transmitters . description: Intelect Mobile RPW Portable Shockwave Therapy Unit is a compact radial pressure wave therapy system designed to provide a non-invasive treatment solution for chronic tendinopathies and other soft tissue disorders. The system is designed with simple, user-friendly navigation , a transport handle and a transmission gel bottle holder for convenient operation. description: The Mobile 2 RPW Radial Pressure Wave Shockwave Therapy System is a versatile shockwave therapy device designed for applications in orthopaedics, physiotherapy, sports medicine, physical medicine, rheumatology, chiropractic care, podiatry, aesthetic therapy, acupuncture, and veterinary treatment. name: Intellect Focus Shockwave Therapy System – Focused Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (F-SW)
description: The Intellect Focus Shockwave Therapy System is a focused extracorporeal shockwave therapy (F-SW) device designed for professional applications where precise treatment of deeper target areas is required. The system generates focused shock waves that are concentrated through a lens and delivered into targeted tissue. Focused shockwave therapy can be used for a range of applications involving bone healing, tendinopathies, muscular trigger points, myofascial pain, dermatology, wound healing, spasticity and erectile dysfunction . Its focused treatment approach allows practitioners to target deeper treatment regions with greater precision. The Intellect Focus Shockwave provides an F-SW frequency range of 1.0–8.0 Hz and energy levels from 0.01 to 0.55 mJ/mm² . The focused shockwaves can penetrate approximately 12 cm , making the system suitable for treatment of deeper target areas. The system can also be used in applications involving calcifications, stones and growths , while focused shockwave therapy is described as supporting the activation of the healing cascade, enhanced blood flow and tissue regeneration. name: Zeus Wave ESWT + HILT Shockwave and High-Intensity Laser Therapy System
description: The Zeus Wave ESWT + HILT is a multifunctional therapy system that combines Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy (ESWT) with High-Intensity Laser Therapy (HILT) in a single platform. The Zeus Wave features both piezo-type and pneumatic-type extracorporeal shockwave technologies . The piezo shockwave system offers adjustable frequencies from 1–8 Hz , eight frequency steps, treatment settings from 1,000–7,000 impulses , and a penetration depth of approximately 5–44 mm when using the specified advanced elastomeric pads. The pneumatic shockwave system provides pressure settings from 0.5–7.0 bar , adjustable shockwave frequencies from 1–10 Hz , and treatment settings from 1,000–10,000 impulses . The system also includes touchscreen operation for convenient adjustment of treatment parameters. The HILT component uses high-intensity laser energy for professional therapeutic applications. The system incorporates safety features including an emergency stop button, HILT interlock, and key switch . The supplied GEL PAD system supports piezo shockwave transmission and allows treatment depth adjustment using different pads, with penetration depths ranging from approximately 5 mm to 40 mm . description: The Therma Tecar Therapy Unit is a professional diathermy system designed for capacitive and resistive energy transfer treatments in physiotherapy and rehabilitation applications. name: Therma Tecar Therapy Unit – Capacitive & Resistive Diathermy System
description:
The Therma Tecar Therapy Unit is a professional diathermy system designed for capacitive and resistive energy transfer treatments in physiotherapy and rehabilitation applications. It is intended for therapeutic treatment of musculoskeletal injuries and osteo-articular conditions, including contractures, sprains, strains, tendonitis, sinusitis, and bursitis, according to the supplied product information.
Therma uses capacitive and resistive treatment modes to deliver energy to targeted tissue layers. The capacitive mode is designed for applications such as drainage and muscle de-contracting with a greater thermal effect, while the resistive mode provides biological stimulation with a comparatively minimal thermal effect.
The unit features a range of preset treatment protocols and customizable programs, allowing professionals to adapt treatment settings to their clinical requirements. Its handpiece provides three working configurations for different therapeutic applications.

The standard YoutecarX configuration operates at 150 Watt, 500 kHz frequency, with unipolar continuous emission. The system includes a unipolar handpiece, steel neutral electrode, 61 mm capacitive and resistive electrodes, power cable, application cable, disposable neutral electrodes, and gel adhesive electrodes.
The system can be expanded with capacitive and resistive electrodes in 41 mm, 61 mm, and 81 mm sizes, as well as bipolar accessories that allow treatment without a neutral plate. Additional configurations include NeutroDinamico® dynamic applications, automatic applications, Joule Mode, and Intimity pelvic floor rehabilitation accessories.
